title: Helsinki framed logo screen

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Give a video a recognizable signature so viewers can associate the preceding content with its source.
strategic_value: A centered framed logo can connect varied Helsinki films through one consistent final identifier.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture compares the framed logo on pink, photographic and wave-divided backgrounds, followed by a proportional placement diagram.
practical_value: Keep the logo centered and size it from the frame height rather than judging each background independently.

content_islands.name: Background alternatives
content_islands.spec: Group three static logo-screen examples with the placement text.

content_islands.name: Proportional diagram
content_islands.spec: Stack a dark central logo between pale copies above and below to illustrate the central one-third height.

ingredient.name: Video signature logo
ingredient.role: Identify the city behind the video.
ingredient.application: Center the framed logo in both directions at one-third of the video height.
ingredient.scope: Logo screens; background may be an image, color or wave motif.

reference_purposes.Application: The section permits image, color and wave backgrounds for the logo screen.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The logo is centered vertically and horizontally and sized to one-third of the video height.
reference_purposes.Expression: Three backgrounds demonstrate different expressions around the same white framed logo.
